questions.question: A retailer bought 250 kg of a cereal and sold it at a profit to the extent of what he paid for 160 kg. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A retailer bought 250 kg of a cereal

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of 250 kg of cereal is Rs. 250

The cost price of 1 kg of cereal is Rs. 1

And the cost price of 160 kg of cereal is Rs. 160

According to the question,

He sold at a profit of Rs. 160

Profit percentage = Profit/CP × 100

Profit percentage = 160/250 × 100 = 64%

∴ **His profit percentage is 64%**

questions.question: The father of a girl is three years older than her mother. Six years ago, the average age of the girl and her parents was 32 years, and the age of the father was twice the present age of his daughter. What is the present age (in years) of the mother?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Father of a girl is three years older than his mother.

The average age of the girl and her parents six years ago was 32 years and the age of the father was twice the present age of the girl.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average of observations × number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let the present age of the girl is 'x' 

So, the age of the father six years ago was '2x'

The age of the girl six years ago was 'x - 6'

The father of a girl is three years older than his mother. So, the mother's age was '2x - 3'

The total age of the girl and her parents six years ago was 32 × 3 = 96 years

The total age of the girl and her parents six years ago was 2x + 2x - 3 + x - 6 = 96 years

5x = 96 + 9 

5x = 105 

x = 21

The age of mother six years ago was 2x - 3 = 2 × 21 - 3 = 39 years

The present age of mother will be 39 + 6 = 45 years

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 4 ∶ 5. If one is subtracted from the first number, and two is added to the second number, then the ratio becomes 3 ∶ 4. What will be the ratio when eight and four are, respectively, added to the first and second number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the two numbers is 4:5

After subtracting one and adding two in the first and second number, the ratio becomes 3:4

**Concept:**

The Cross Multiplication method is used.

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers be 4x and 5x

According to the question,

(4x - 1)/(5x + 2) = 3/4

16x - 4 = 15x + 6

16x - 15x = 6 + 4

x = 10

First number = 4x = 4 × 10 = 40

Second number = 5x = 5 × 10 = 50

After adding eight and four to the first and second numbers we get

First number = 40 + 8 = 48

Second number = 50 + 4 = 54

Required ratio = 48 : 54

** The ratio will be 8 : 9**

questions.question: The average of ten numbers is A. If c is subtracted from each number, except the tenth, and (c - 1) is subtracted from the tenth number, then what will be the new average?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of ten numbers is A.

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total number of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Total of ten numbers is 10A.

Total of ten numbers when c is subtracted from each number is 10A - 9C - (C-1)

New average will be = (10A - 9C - C + 1)/10 

∴ **New average is A - C + 0.1**

questions.question: The total surface area of a hemisphere is very nearly equal to that of an equilateral triangle. The side of the triangle is how many times (approximately) of the radius of the hemisphere?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total surface area of a hemisphere is very nearly equal to that of an equilateral triangle.

**Formula Used:**

The total surface area of a hemisphere = 3πr²

Area of an equilateral triangle = √3/4 × side²

**Calculation:** 

According to the question,

The total surface area of a hemisphere = Area of an equilateral triangle

⇒ 3πr² = √3/4 × side²

⇒ side² = √3× 4× π× r²

⇒ side/r = (√3× 4× π)⁰.⁵ 

**∴ ****The side of the triangle is approximately (√3× 4× π)⁰.⁵ times of the radius.**

questions.question: Two cyclists start simultaneously from two points A and B, their destinations being B and A, respectively. After crossing each other; they precisely take 2 hours 33 minutes 36 seconds and 1 hour 26 minutes 24 seconds respectively to reach their destinations. What is the ratio of the speed of the first to that of the second cyclist?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two cyclists travel equal distances from points A and B.

**Concept Used:**

When distance is the same then speed is inversely proportional to the time.

**Note: **

If after crossing each other they take x and y time to reach their destinations then,

Speed₁/Speed₂ = √(T₂/T₁)

1 hour = 60 min

1 min = 60 sec

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Time is taken by first after crossing, T₁ = 2 hours 33 min 36 sec

⇒ (2 × 3600 + 33 × 60 + 36) sec

⇒ (7200 + 1980 + 36) = 9216 sec

Time is taken by second after crossing, T₂ = 1 hour 26 min 24 sec

⇒ (1 × 3600 + 26 × 60 + 24) sec

⇒ 3600 + 1560 + 24) = 5184 sec

Now,

⇒ Speed of first, (s₁)/speed of second, (s₂) = √(T₂/T₁)

⇒ √(5184/9216)

⇒ √(324/576) = 18/24

⇒ s₁ : s₂ = 18 : 24

⇒ 3 : 4

 **∴ The ratio of the speed of the first to that of the second cyclist is 3 : 4** .

questions.question: By what percentage is the percentage of the number of vowels in the word CONSONANT less than the percentage of consonants in it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In the word CONSONANT, there are 3 vowels and 6 consonants.

**Formula Used:**

Required percentage = (Percentage of consonants - Percentage of Vowels)/Percentage of consonants × 100

Vowels are a,e,i,o,u

Consonants are alphabets other than vowels.

**Calculation:**

Total number of letter in CONSONANT = 9

The number of vowel in the word CONSONANT are O,O, A = 3

The number of consonant in the word CONSONANT are C,N,S,N,N,T = 6

Percentage of vowels = 3/9 × 100 = 33.33%

Percentage of consonants = 6/9 × 100 = 66.66%

Required % = (66.66% - 33.33%)/66.66% × 100 = 50%

**∴ The percentage of vowels is 50% less than the percentage of consonants.**

questions.question:
The speed of light is very nearly equal to 3 × 10¹⁷ nanometre per second. How much time (in seconds), approximately, does it take light to travel from the moon to the earth, the average distance between them being 384000 km?

(1 nanometre = 10⁻⁹ metre)
questions.solution:
Given:

The speed of light is very nearly equal to 3 × 1017 nanometre per second.

The average distance between them being 384000 km

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

1 km = 1000 m

1 nanometre = 10-9 metre

Calculation:

Speed of light = 3 × 1017 × 10-9 = 3 × 10⁸ mps

Time taken by light to travel from the moon to the earth = (384000 × 1000) ÷ (3 × 108) = 1.28 seconds

**∴ 1.28 seconds light takes to travel from the moon to the earth.**

questions.question: Two inlet pipes can separately fill a cistern completely in 8 hours and 10 hours, respectively. They are operated for 2 hours, after which the second pipe is closed, and an outlet pipe which can drain out water from the full cistern in 20 hours is opened. How much time will it take to fill the cistern completely from the instant of opening the outlet pipe?
questions.solution:
Given:

Two inlet pipes can separately fill a cistern completely in 8 hours and 10 hours, respectively. They are operated for 2 hours, after which the second pipe is closed, and an outlet pipe which can drain out water from the full cistern in 20 hours is opened. 

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken 

1 hour = 60 minutes

Calculation:

LCM (8, 10) = 40

Let the capacity of the tank be the LCM of 8, 10.

Hence, the capacity of the tank = 40 units

Efficiencies (per hour),

First pipe = 40 ÷ 8 = 5 units

Second pipe = 40 ÷ 10 = 4 units

Outlet pipe = 40 ÷ 20 = 2 units

In first two hours, tank was filled by = 2 × (5 + 4) = 18 units

Remaining = 40 - 18 = 22 units

Here, the efficiency is taken negative since it's draining the water outside. 

Then, taken taken to fill the tank = 22 over (5 - 2) = 71 over 3 hours = 7 hours 20 minutes 

**∴ It will take to fill the cistern completely from the instant of opening the outlet pipe 7 hours 20 minutes.**

questions.question: An article, whose list price was Rs. 720, was subject to two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. What is the amount (in Rs.) of discount that a customer would get while purchasing the article?
questions.solution:
Given:

List price of the item = Rs. 720

Two successive discounts of 20% and 10%.

Concept used:

Final discount percentage after two successive discounts of A% and B% = (A + B - {AB over 100})\%

Calculation:

Final discount percentage = 20 + 10 - {20 × 10} over 100 = 28%

Hence, the discount availled by the customer = 720 × 28% = Rs. 201.6

**∴ Rs. 201.6 of discount the customer would get while purchasing the article.**

questions.question: If a shopkeeper purchases a certain number of items for a certain sum and sells a fraction of the said number for the same amount, then his profit is 300%. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Given:

The shopkeeper purchases a certain number of items for a certain sum and sells a fraction of the said number for the same amount, then his profit is 300%

Concept used: 

Profit% = {(Selling Price - Cost Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Calculation:

Let's suppose the shopkeeper purchases P unit of an item at Rs. Q and sells R unit of at Rs. Q.

Hence, the cost price of each unit item = Rs. (Q/P)

Hence, the selling price of each unit item = Rs. (Q/R)

Profit = {Q over R} - {Q over P}

According to the question,

{Q over R} - {Q over P} over {Q over P} × 100 = 300

⇒ (P - R) over R = 3

⇒ {P over R} - 1 = 3

⇒ {P over R} = 4

⇒ {R over P} = {1 over 4}

**∴ The fraction is {1 over 4}.**

questions.question: A batswoman missed her century by four runs in an innings, in which the scoring shots in the form of sixes, fours, threes, twos and singles, were in the proportion 1 ∶ 3 ∶ 2 ∶ 7 ∶ 10. How many runs did she score in singles?
questions.solution:
Given:

A batswoman missed her century by four runs in an innings, in which the scoring shots in the form of sixes, fours, threes, twos, and singles, were in the proportion 1 ∶ 3 ∶ 2 ∶ 7 ∶ 10. 

Concept used:

Ratio Proportion

Century comprises 100 runs. 

Calculation:

Her score = 100 - 4 = 96 runs

Let the common ratio be Q.

Hence, the scoring shots in the form of sixes, fours, threes, twos, and singles were Q, 3Q, 2Q, 7Q, and 10Q.

According to the question,

Q × 6 + 3Q × 4 + 2Q × 3 + 7Q × 2 + 10Q = 96

⇒ 48Q = 96

⇒ Q = 2

⇒ 10Q = 20

∴ She scored in singles 20.
